name: Massimo, the Magician — "If a card is exiled this way, that creature gains" is the creature that entered
notes: Sweep group 7 (2026-10-07). The lead "If a card is exiled this way," kept "that creature" from being read, so the fired trigger did nothing. The lead is dropped in the fired text (assumed done, as "if you do" is); the trigger takes the creature that entered as its pick and gives it the quoted ability. Massimo itself gains nothing.

$includes: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, copy the exiled card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.

$excludes: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, copy the exiled card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
